name: image-generation-loader

frames.best_why: The pixel band sits mid-image on all three tiles, showing the sweep and its coloured cells clearly.

tagline: Pixel-grid band sweeps down a photo like the image is being rendered.
summary: A transparent layer for pictures: a strip of small coloured squares travels down the frame, tinting the image and revealing it as it passes. It can also spell a short word in blocky pixels.
appearance: Photo tiles with a horizontal strip of tiny square cells laid across them, in blue-green or pink tones. The cells pulse in two shades, a soft glow fades above and below the strip, and a thin caption row sits under each tile.
behaviour: The band moves from above the image to below it on a repeating cycle, squares flickering between the two accent colours while the picture shows through. Setting the effect to wave bends the band, scale-wave swells the cells, and text makes the band draw pixel letters.
demo_content: Three photos: an alpine ridge, white horses in a field, and a smiling woman in a red top, each captioned with a prompt.
search_phrases: pixel scan line over an image
glowing bar sweeping down a photo
pixelated text mask on a photo
use_when: An image is being generated or fetched and the wait should feel like part of the reveal.
avoid_when: The band loops for as long as it is mounted, so it must be removed when loading actually finishes.
customise: Effect variant, the two accent colours, optional pixel text, cell size, band height, speed and overlay opacity are props; the pixel font and easing maths live in the file.
weight_why: A requestAnimationFrame canvas redraw of a few hundred cells, paused while off-screen.

a11y.note: Both layers are aria-hidden and purely decorative; reduced-motion freezes the band instead of sweeping it.

props.name: easing
props.type: string | [number, number, number, number] | ((p: number) => number)

issues: The caption text is very small and faint against the dark caption strip.
The pixel word "Generating" set on the first tile is not legible in any frame.
polish_why: Lively per-cell animation and a convincing reveal; tiny captions and a faint pixel word cost it.
title: Image Generation Loader
